Title: CYF Expansion - Choose Your Pod
Description:
Adds 8 custom player tiles with isopods.

[b]How to use it?[/b]
This mod requires the [i]Choose Your Fighter[/i] mod. During character creation (or when visiting a gutsmonger) you can set your character's tile.

When setting the tile:
1. Click on the [i]Expansions[/i] option and select [i]Choose Your Pod[/i]
2. Select your favourite isopod
3. You can also change the primary and detail colours to create your own isopod


Enjoy and don't take it too seriously!
